mapper.insert: INSERT INTO receipt_weighing_record (purchase_receipt_item_id, raw_reading, confirmed_reading, unit, source, device_session_id, modification_reason, recorded_at, operator, created_by) VALUES (#{row.purchaseReceiptItemId}, #{row.rawReading}, #{row.confirmedReading}, #{row.unit}, #{row.source}, #{row.deviceSessionId}, #{row.modificationReason}, #{row.recordedAt}, #{row.operator}, #{row.createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM receipt_weighing_record WHERE purchase_receipt_item_id = #{purchaseReceiptItemId} ORDER BY recorded_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT w.* FROM receipt_weighing_record w JOIN purchase_receipt_item ri ON ri.id = w.purchase_receipt_item_id AND ri.deleted = FALSE WHERE ri.purchase_receipt_id = #{purchaseReceiptId} ORDER BY w.recorded_at DESC, w.id DESC
